description: Every family of subsets of the natural numbers of size less than the pseudointersection number leaves some infinite set unsplit by every member.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.small_family_has_unsplit_set (F : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hc : Cardinal.mk ↑F < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.pseudointersectionNumber) :
  ∃ P, P.Infinite ∧ ∀ S ∈ F, ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.Splits S P
